recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR-core source follow-up is needed; any desire to redirect legacy canonical URLs should be handled as publication infrastructure or historical archive policy work rather than as a current spec source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-6909 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core technical correction from the 2015 May SDC ballot. It reported that http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/iso21090-ST-translation generated a 404 from the FHIR-core profiles/SDC context, with a resolution that the link would stop being broken once DSTU2 was published.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-6909 was found. Source history shows the old SDC DataElement note used StructureDefinition/iso21090-ST-translation after git-svn commit 2b54214b7e and was removed from core when SDC moved out in 7fc9007c49. The checked-in DSTU2 release-history bundle contains the iso21090-ST-translation StructureDefinition, aligning with the publication-based resolution.
additional_context: Current core build inputs do not reference iso21090-ST-translation outside tools/history/release2. The active ISO 21090 profile source remains in fhir.ini but has no ST-translation entry; current multi-language guidance links to the newer translation extension in the FHIR Extension Pack. Later FHIR-12154 retired the old iso21090-ST-translation pattern and is already represented by a no-change reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the obsolete canonical or adding current guidance for it would conflict with later applied cleanup; the only remaining 404 is for a retired legacy URL not linked by current core source.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue removed the old iso21090-ST-translation and iso21090-ST-language extensions and is already represented on the combined branch.
